Traffic Advisory

In Connection with PWD Work near Petrol Pump, Majnu Ka Tila | 15.07.2025 (Tuesday), traffic movement will be affected during late-night hours.

Diversions will be in place on Outer Ring Road between Chandgiram Akhara, Wazirabad Flyover, and ISBT Kashmere Gate.

Plan your journey accordingly and avoid the affected stretches between 01:30 AM to 03:00 AM.

#DTPUpdates

TRAFFIC ADVISORY: The North Texas Tollway Authority has notified the City of Carrollton that the east- and westbound PGBT to southbound I-35E ramps will close nightly from 10pm-5am, July 14-17, for TXDOT work.

Eastbound drivers should exit at Sandy Lake Road and follow signs to I-35E. Westbound drivers should exit at Old Denton Road/Dickerson Parkway and follow signs to I-35E. For questions, contact NTTA.
